bearing_id_is_a_file.finding: bearing_id is one per .mat file. CWRU has 40 files and 10 physical bearings (the four files per bearing are the same bearing at 0/1/2/3 hp), so a 'bearing-wise' split puts the same physical bearing on both sides

flat_directory_labels.finding: label is derived from directory names; CWRU is published as flat numbered .mat files, so every record falls through to ('normal','0')

model_selection_on_test.finding: the loader passed to evaluate() each epoch is test_loader, and the checkpoint kept is the one with the best macro F1 on it. Early stopping and model selection therefore read the test fold, so the reported figure is a best-of-N over epochs
model_selection_on_test.note: a separate validation fold is not actually available in CWRU: every fold that is not the test fold shares a physical bearing with it, which is the same structural limit this branch reports. The honest options are a fixed epoch budget or nested cross-validation over units, not selection on the test fold.
